headline: Worldwide PC shipments fell about 20 percent in Q3, IDC says
summary: IDC reports worldwide PC shipments fell roughly 20 percent in the third quarter from a year earlier, the sharpest such decline since the first quarter of 2023. Outlets cite worsening macro conditions and warn the downturn could deepen in coming quarters, possibly marking the start of a new downward cycle.
